Dealing ability damage to <link Elite, Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> targets grants 4 stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for <pve 16 /> <pvp [11] /> seconds.

The buff's duration cannot be refreshed.

source.text:
Upon dealing Ability Damage to an Elite, Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Guardian: 
Grants x4 Ability Element-Matching Weapon Surge for 16 [11] seconds.
Buff is not refreshable.
